topic: EARN: a 20-minute one-item listing, picking one unused thing from a closet, taking three daylight photos, writing three plain lines, and setting a price before posting
pillar: EARN: small, realistic ways to bring money in or make a skill pay, with no promises about amounts.
caption:
That thing in the hall closet you keep stepping around could be today's EARN step. 📦

Pick one item you no longer use.
Take three photos by a window, flaws included.
Write three plain lines and choose a price before anyone messages you.
If it might be shared property, check with your lawyer first.

Save this for a quiet twenty minutes this weekend.

The free Three Numbers Starter Sheet gives the money a place to land. It's one page, link in bio.

Day one counts.

General education, not financial advice.

slides.title: Turn one closet item into a listing today
slides.subtitle: A 20-minute EARN step, phone only

slides.title: One item, one listing, twenty minutes
slides.body: Today you pick one thing you no longer use and write a listing for it. That is the whole step. All you need is a phone or a laptop.

slides.title: Pick the item
items: Open one closet. The hall closet is a good place to start.
Look for something clean, working, and unused for a year
Choose one thing you can carry by yourself
If it might be shared property, ask your lawyer first

slides.title: Take three photos in daylight
items: Wipe it down with a damp cloth
Set it on a plain surface near a window
Shoot the front, the back, and any flaws
Showing flaws up front means fewer questions later

slides.title: Write three plain lines
slides.body: Line one, what it is and the brand. Line two, size and condition, flaws included. Line three, how pickup works. Short and clear is plenty.

slides.title: Pick a price you can live with
slides.body: Look up a few similar listings on the site you plan to use. Choose a number you would be glad to get. Write it down before anyone messages you.

slides.title: A quick safety check
items: Read the site's selling rules once
Plan to meet in a busy public place
Tell a friend when and where you are meeting
Have the money go into an account in your name

slides.title: Give it a line on your sheet
slides.body: Save this for a quiet twenty minutes. If it sells, add it under what's coming in on the free Three Numbers Starter Sheet, link in bio. Day one counts.
